# Plesk
> Plesk is a web hosting control panel for building, securing, automating, and managing websites, applications, servers, and hosting environments.

Plesk provides hosting automation, server and site management, security tooling, WordPress management, extensions, and partner resources for service providers, developers, and IT administrators.

## Product
- [Plesk Obsidian](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-obsidian/): Overview of the current Plesk platform release and core hosting management capabilities.
- [Web Admin Edition](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-editions/): Entry-level edition for managing websites, domains, mail, and hosting tasks.
- [Web Pro Edition](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-editions/): Edition for web professionals managing multiple sites and subscriptions.
- [Web Host Edition](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-editions/): Full edition for hosting providers, resellers, and large-scale multi-tenant environments.
- [Pricing](https://www.plesk.com/pricing/): Licensing and subscription options for Plesk editions and add-on features.
- [Extensions](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/): Marketplace for add-ons that extend security, development, backup, and management features.

## Solutions
- [WordPress Toolkit](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/wordpress-toolkit/): Centralized WordPress installation, staging, security hardening, and update management.
- [Plesk for VPS Hosting](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-vps-hosting/): Control panel capabilities tailored for virtual private server environments.
- [Plesk for Dedicated Servers](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-dedicated-server/): Hosting management for dedicated infrastructure and high-control deployments.
- [Plesk for Cloud](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-cloud/): Plesk deployment and management options for cloud-based hosting environments.
- [Plesk for Developers](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-developers/): Tools and workflows for application deployment, Git, Docker, and automation.
- [Plesk for Agencies](https://www.plesk.com/plesk-agencies/): Site and client management features for digital agencies and web professionals.

## Documentation
- [Plesk Documentation](https://docs.plesk.com/): Main documentation portal for administrators, developers, and hosting providers.
- [Administrator Guide](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/): Core administration tasks for managing servers, subscriptions, domains, and services.
- [Reseller Guide](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/reseller-guide/): Documentation for reseller account management and customer hosting operations.
- [Customer Guide](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/customer-guide/): End-user documentation for websites, mail, databases, and application hosting.
- [Migration Guide](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/migration-guide/): Instructions for migrating hosting data and services into Plesk.
- [CLI Guide](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/cli-linux/): Command-line tools and automation commands for Linux-based Plesk servers.
- [CLI Guide for Windows](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/cli-win/): Command-line reference and usage for Windows-based Plesk installations.
- [Advanced Administration Guide](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/advanced-administration-guide-linux/): Advanced Linux administration, customization, and service configuration topics.

## Developer & API
- [Plesk Developer Documentation](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/api-rpc/about-xml-api.28709/): Entry point for XML API and integration concepts.
- [XML API Reference](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/api-rpc/about-xml-api.28709/): Overview of the Plesk XML API architecture and usage.
- [REST API Reference](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/api-rpc/about-rest-api.79359/): REST API concepts for integrating with Plesk programmatically.
- [CLI Utility Reference](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/cli-linux/using-command-line-utilities.59409/): Command-line automation reference for common administrative operations.
- [Extensions SDK](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/extensions-guide/): Guide to building, packaging, and maintaining Plesk extensions.
- [Docker Extension Documentation](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/plesk-administration/using-docker.75823/): Using Docker containers from within the Plesk interface.
- [Git Support Documentation](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/website-management/git-support.75825/): Deploying and managing websites with Git integration in Plesk.

## WordPress
- [WP Toolkit](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/wordpress-toolkit/): Official WordPress management extension for installation, staging, cloning, and security.
- [WP Toolkit Documentation](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/website-management/wp-toolkit.73390/): Administrator documentation for managing WordPress instances with WP Toolkit.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.plesk.com/wordpress-hosting/): Plesk capabilities and positioning for WordPress hosting environments.
- [WordPress Security](https://www.plesk.com/blog/various/wordpress-security-checklist/): Practical guidance for securing WordPress sites and hosting setups.
- [WordPress Management](https://www.plesk.com/blog/product-technology/wordpress-management-plesk-wp-toolkit/): Overview of WordPress management workflows using Plesk tools.

## Security & Operations
- [Security Advisor](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/server-administration/security-advisor.73383/): Built-in recommendations for improving Plesk server security posture.
- [Fail2Ban in Plesk](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/server-administration/fail2ban.73376/): Intrusion prevention and brute-force protection configuration in Plesk.
- [SSL/TLS Certificates](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/website-management/ssl-tls-certificates.65183/): Managing certificates and HTTPS settings for hosted domains.
- [Backup and Restore](https://docs.plesk.com/en-US/obsidian/administrator-guide/backing-up-and-restoration.59256/): Backup strategies and restoration procedures for Plesk environments.
- [Monitoring Extension](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/monitoring/): Server and service monitoring extension for operational visibility.
- [ImunifyAV](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/imunifyav/): Malware scanning extension for detecting infected files in hosting environments.

## Extensions
- [Extensions Catalog](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/): Browse available Plesk extensions by category and use case.
- [WP Toolkit](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/wordpress-toolkit/): WordPress lifecycle management extension for administrators and hosting providers.
- [SEO Toolkit](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/seo-toolkit/): Search optimization and site auditing tools integrated into Plesk.
- [Security Advisor](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/security-advisor/): Extension for reviewing and improving server security settings.
- [Docker](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/docker/): Container management extension for running and exposing Dockerized applications.
- [Git](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/git/): Git deployment support for version-controlled website publishing.
- [Let’s Encrypt](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/sslit/): Free SSL certificate provisioning and renewal through Plesk.
- [Backup to Cloud Pro](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/backup-to-cloud-pro/): Cloud backup extension for remote storage and recovery workflows.
